saw_lines: Skin and hair buyers choose by active ingredient and whether an expert backs it, then reorder the same product for months.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before the buyer checks whether the product fits their skin.
Your 3 of 9 copy ads repeat one exact copy, so keep it, swap the opening line and creative in each, and test two new angles against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 3 of 9 copy ads, so the same words repeat across your account. Keep that copy, swap the opening line and the creative in each, and test two new angles against it.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
3 of 9 copy ads open on the same AI skin analysis line, so one hook carries the account. Write two new openers around another reason to buy, such as price, and test them against it.

21 of your 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so the feed gives buyers no reason to stop. Add three story ads that open on a customer moment or a daily routine, then test them against the catalog.

ads_1: New openers beyond the AI skin check, tested against a price angle
